title: Visualization of α-synuclein trafficking via nanogold labeling and electron microscopy
protocol: Add 48 μL of 5 mg/mL PFFs to 60 μL of the reaction buffer provided with the nanogold conjugation kit.
Thaw reaction buffer for 1 hour on ice.
Retrieve 48 μL of 5 mg/mL PFFs and add to it 60 μL of ice-cold reaction buffer.
Incubate the mixture for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Slowly pipette the mixture up and down.
Add the reaction buffer-PFFs mixture to 1 vial of 5 nm nanogold.
Incubate for 1 hour at 18°C.
Add 10 μL of quencher buffer to the mixture.
Slowly pipette up and down using a p10 pipette set at 10 μL.
Avoid creating bubbles in the solution.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Prepare a diluted sample of PFFs with a concentration of 1 mg/mL using ddH2O.
Place one drop of diluted PFFs on a carbon/formvar covered copper grid.
Allow the sample to sit for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Using Whatman filter paper, remove the drop from the grid.
Fix the PFFs sample on the grid using 2% PFA retrieved immediately from storage at 4°C.
Place one drop onto the grid.
Let the sample sit for 10 min at room temperature.
Remove PFA drop using filter paper.
Add one drop of ddH2O onto the grid for 1 min at room temperature.
Remove with filter paper.
Repeat once more.
Stain the grid with Uranyless.
Centrifuge 1 mL of Uranlyess at 14,000 × g.
Add one drop of the supernatant to the grid and wait for 5 min at room temperature.
Wash grid with ddH2O as detailed in d.
Remove the drop using a Whatman filter paper.
Let the grid sit overnight on parafilm at room temperature.
Place grids in a box/chamber for their storage overnight to avoid addition of contaminants.
Treat 8-well Permanox plates with poly-L-lysine.
Wash wells with 100% ethanol.
Repeat washing with 100% ethanol three times.
Wash wells with ddH2O.
Repeat washing with ddH2O three times.
Add 200 μL of 0.01% poly-L-lysine to each well.
Incubate wells for 1 hour at 37°C.
Wash wells with ddH2O.
Repeat washing with ddH2O three times.
Subculture U2OS cells.
Trypsinize U2OS cells in culture, pellet cells, remove supernatant.
Resuspend cells with growth media.
Plate approximately 50,000 cells per well.
Incubate for 48–72 hours.
Add 5 μL of conjugated PFFs to each well.
Incubate cells for 30 min at 37°C.
Remove cell media.
Place cells on ice.
Administer 200 μL of ice-cold trypsin (0.05%) to each well.
Incubate for 60–90 s on ice.
Remove trypsin.
Wash cells with 200 μL of ice-cold PBS.
Fix cells with 2.5% glutaraldehyde supplemented with 2 mM CaCl2.
Fix cells at 4°C overnight.
Wash cells with 0.1 mM sodium cacodylate buffer.
Remove fixative solution.
Add 200 μL of sodium cacodylate buffer to each well.
Aspirate the buffer.
Replace with 200 μL of sodium cacodylate buffer.
Wash out glutaraldehyde fixative.
Remove fixative.
Add 300 μL of 0.1 M sodium cacodylate buffer.
Incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Repeat washing with 0.1 M sodium cacodylate buffer twice.
Post-fix samples using 1% osmium tetroxide and 1.5% potassium ferrocyanide in ddH2O.
Add potassium ferrocyanide powder to ddH2O.
Dilute the appropriate amount of osmium tetroxide into the mixture.
Add 200 μL of the post-fixative mixture to each well.
Incubate at 4°C for 1–2 h.
Wash out the post-fixative solution.
Wash cells with ddH2O.
Incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Repeat washing and incubation steps twice.
Aspirate ddH2O.
Add 30% ethanol/ddH2O diluted using pure ethanol.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 min.
Repeat dehydration process with 50%, 60%, and 70% ethanol solutions, each for 10 min.
Prepare a solution of 2% uranyl acetate in 70% ethanol.
Add 200 μL of staining solution to each well.
Incubate at 4°C for 2 h.
Wash out the staining solution.
Aspirate samples.
Wash samples twice with 70% ethanol.
Aspirate wells.
Add 80% ethanol solution to each well.
Incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Repeat steps i-iii once more.
Remove the solution.
Add 90% ethanol solution to each well.
Incubate for 15 min at room temperature.
Repeat steps v-vi once more.
Remove the solution.
Add 100% ethanol solution to each well.
Incubate for 15 min at room temperature.
Remove the solution.
Repeat steps viii-x twice more.
Infiltrate with Epon-812.
Add a 50% solution of Epon-812 (diluted in 100% ethanol) to each well.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 h.
Aspirate wells.
Add a 75% solution of Epon-812/ethanol to each well.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 h.
Aspirate wells.
Add a 100% solution of Epon-812 to each well.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 h.
Aspirate wells.
Incubate samples with Epon-812 at 60°C for 48 h.
Allow samples to cool at room temperature overnight before sectioning.
Trim the block to a small area of interest using a light microscope.
Use a diamond knife to section samples.
Place one section onto a grid using the Perfect Loop tool.
Place the grid onto a Whatman filter paper and allow it to dry.
Stain grids with uranyl acetate and lead citrate.
